questions.q: If $x > 0$, which expression is equivalent to $\sqrt[3]{x^6 \cdot x^9}$?
questions.answer: Combine exponents: $x^6 \cdot x^9 = x^{15}$. Then $\sqrt[3]{x^{15}} = x^{15/3} = x^5$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Exponential Growth and Decay Models

questions.q: A town had a population of $12,000$ in the year $2010$ and increases by $3.5\%$ each year. Which function models the population $P(t)$, where $t$ is the number of years since $2010$?
questions.answer: Growth formula is $P(t) = P_0(1 + r)^t$. Here $r = 0.035$, so the multiplier is $1 + 0.035 = 1.035$. Thus $P(t) = 12000(1.035)^t$.

questions.q: A certain medication decays in the bloodstream according to $A(t) = 500(0.75)^t$, where $A(t)$ is in milligrams and $t$ is in hours. By what percentage does the amount of medication decrease each hour?
questions.answer: The base is $b = 1 - r = 0.75 \Rightarrow r = 0.25$, which represents a $25\%$ hourly decrease.

questions.q: An investment account triples in value every $8$ years. If the initial balance is 1,500 dollars, which expression represents the account balance after $t$ years?
questions.answer: When an amount triples every $k$ years, the model is $A(t) = A_0 \cdot 3^{t/k}$. Here $k = 8$, yielding $1500(3)^{t/8}$.

questions.q: Which expression is the quotient when $2x^3 - 5x^2 + 7x - 4$ is divided by $x - 1$?
questions.answer:
Use polynomial division or synthetic division with $c = 1$:
$1 | 2 \quad -5 \quad 7 \quad -4$
$\quad \downarrow \quad 2 \quad -3 \quad 4$
$\quad 2 \quad -3 \quad 4 \quad 0$. The quotient is $2x^2 - 3x + 4$ with remainder $0$.

questions.q: If polynomial $P(x) = x^3 - kx^2 + 4x - 12$ has a zero at $x = 3$, what is the value of $k$?
questions.answer: By the Factor Theorem, $P(3) = 0 \Rightarrow 3^3 - k(3^2) + 4(3) - 12 = 0 \Rightarrow 27 - 9k + 12 - 12 = 0 \Rightarrow 27 - 9k = 0 \Rightarrow k = 3$.

questions.q: Which of the following is equivalent to $(3x - 2)(x^2 + 4x - 5)$?
A polynomial function $f(x)$ has zeros at $x = -2, 1, 4$. Which equation could define $f$?
questions.answer: A polynomial with roots $r_1, r_2, r_3$ factors as $a(x - r_1)(x - r_2)(x - r_3)$. Substituting $-2, 1, 4$ gives $(x + 2)(x - 1)(x - 4)$.

questions.q: The graph of $y = (x - 3)^2(x + 1)$ touches the $x$-axis without crossing it at which value of $x$?
questions.answer: A factor with an even multiplicity, such as $(x - 3)^2$, causes the graph to be tangent to the $x$-axis (touch without crossing) at $x = 3$.

questions.q: What is the degree of the polynomial function $g(x) = (x^2 - 1)(2x - 3)^3$?
questions.answer: The degree of a product is the sum of the degrees: degree of $(x^2 - 1)$ is $2$, degree of $(2x - 3)^3$ is $3$. Total degree $= 2 + 3 = 5$.
